notes.title: Close Me receiving a big update in September, DLC delisted in September too
notes.content:
Close Me will be receiving a big update in September. The update will add the previously DLC exclusive gameplay content for New Game+ into the base game, when you beat the game once several new areas open up, as well as an extended ending plays if you complete the new areas on your second run or later. This was already part of the DLC, it just now will be put into the main game. Additionally, there will be several brand new random events added into the game that I'm adding as part of the 10-year anniversary celebration of Yai Gameworks, a new bigger secret will be added to the game, as well as Steam Achievements are being added.



The DLC "New Game+" will be delisted in September as well and be no longer available. Owners of the DLC will receive a brand new costume you can change into any time in the closet in the main room in the game, this costume is simply a "thank you" for those who bought the DLC to support the game, and won't be available to anyone else after the DLC is delisted. Additionally, the soundtrack will remain in the files for those who bought the DLC before it was removed as well.



I hope you guys enjoy the new additions being brought to Close Me!



For other Yai Gameworks going-ons, I'll be releasing the final update to Feast Your Eyes on August 31st (the 10-year anniversary of the Steam release of the original Close Your Eyes), a direct story sequel to the original Close Your Eyes. This update will have a major art overhaul to Chapters 1 & 2 of that game, add voice acting, add new areas, new story, new horrors, as well as Steam achievements. And finally, it'll release Chapter 3, finishing that game's story and making that game complete as well.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/712260/Feast_Your_Eyes/"][/dynamiclink]

Finally, on October 14th/15th, I'll be releasing a brand new game titled Inferbito. Far more on that in September/October. I hope it'll interest you.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1624490/Inferbito/"][/dynamiclink]

I hope you guys are having a wonderful day!

notes.title: Some Patch Notes
notes.content:
Game should be complete outside of suggestions/tunings I make. Content wise it's complete, but I did make a few changes due to seeing the reaction of some people: 

-Made the 'black screen' puzzle easier (it's no longer just a black screen to clue in a bit what it's about)

-Added a few hidden events earlier into the game for those poor wandering souls.

-Made '75' much easier.

-Added some additional wall hints for what key opens what.

-Some minor fixes here and there.

Hope you guys are enjoying this little experimental game, and hope these additions help you enjoy it more. The update should push out for all shortly, but if you want it immediately just relaunch Steam and it should download.
